prompt: whats the derivative of x^3 * sin(x)
text:
Use the **product rule**:

If  
$$f(x)=x^3\sin(x)$$

then  
$$f'(x)=(x^3)'\sin(x)+x^3(\sin(x))'$$

Compute each derivative:

- $(x^3)' = 3x^2$
- $(\sin x)' = \cos x$

So the derivative is:

$$f'(x)=3x^2\sin(x)+x^3\cos(x)$$

You can also factor it:

$$f'(x)=x^2\left(3\sin(x)+x\cos(x)\right)$$
